question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
SELECT 
    vc.category_name,
    substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) as year,
    ROUND(AVG(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(SUM(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" * vt."qty_sold(kg)"), 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(vl."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(vt."qty_sold(kg)" * vl."loss_rate_%"/ 100.0), 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" * vt."qty_sold(kg)") - SUM(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg" * vt."qty_sold(kg)"), 2) as profit
FROM veg_whsle_df vw
JOIN veg_cat vc ON vw.item_code = vc.item_code
JOIN veg_txn_df vt ON vw.item_code = vt.item_code 
    AND substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 10) = substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 10)
JOIN veg_loss_rate_df vl ON vw.item_code = vl.item_code
WHERE substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
    AND vt."sale/return" = 'sale'
GROUP BY vc.category_name, substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY year, category_name;

How this database is organised (written by an LLM from the tables' notes and keys):
The database contains three distinct datasets. bitcoin_transactions records trades and joins to bitcoin_members via member_id. customer_transactions records individual transactions. customer_nodes links customers to regions via region_id, which joins to customer_regions. veg_txn_df records vegetable sales and joins to veg_cat and veg_loss_rate_df via item_code, and to veg_whsle_df via item_code and date. shopping_cart_events records user interactions, joining to shopping_cart_page_hierarchy via page_id and to shopping_cart_users via cookie_id. weekly_sales and cleaned_weekly_sales provide aggregated sales summaries without explicit joins to other tables in this schema.
